notes.title: English Version Update 2023/03/15
notes.content: This update mainly introduces the English version of the game. In order to allow players from around the world to experience the game more quickly, the team tried to use AI to assist in game translation. After careful proofreading, an astonishingly ideal version has been completed. Thanks all players around the world for their patience and support.

notes.title: Update announcement as of March 6th, 2023 ver 2.0.1
notes.content:
Fixed the issue with the generation of the Boss - Lu Whale in Chapter 2.
Fixed the abnormal mission flow for Mr. Kangaroo in Chapter 2.
Fixed the abnormal display of the map icon for the Fallen Leaves Plains in Chapter 2.

notes.title: The issue regarding languages.
notes.content: Due to the increased workload of localization after the content update, we have temporarily disabled the language options that have not yet been localized. Localization work for each language is still ongoing, and we want to provide the best gaming experience for players in all regions. We will release more language options as soon as possible and hope for your understanding.

notes.title: 《銀斧The Honest Elf》將於2023/3/5正式發售！
notes.content:
很高興終於能宣佈，《銀斧The Honest Elf》將於今年３月５日結束搶先體驗，於Steam更新為2.0.0正式版本，正式發售！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124501/373cb053b997d914387de0c1b1498b366ab1ddfa.jpg[/img]

感謝各位一路以來的支持，本次更新除了帶給各位玩家引頸期盼第二章遊戲內容《雷之塔》外，我們也為第一章的關卡做了不少優化，像是增加「快速移動」的系統，優化「銀斧灌注」的能力等等，小樹苗的戰鬥與操作也在這一年多的打磨下進行了全面的更新。

版本更新後，只要開啟Steam遊戲就會自動更新為2.0.0版，等待下載完成就能開始體驗遊戲。在Early Access版通關第一章的朋友們，可以選擇之前的通關紀錄，在進入遊戲後，只要重新走一次第一章結局，就可以開啟第二章的故事。當然，我們也非常推薦開啟全新一輪的遊戲，複習「環湖試煉」的劇情之餘，順便幫手指復健，畢竟在第二章中，小樹苗即將展開的冒險，可是比環湖的旅程更加具有挑戰性！

希望各位朋友能持續留意銀斧的後續消息，推坑喜好2D動作遊戲的朋友一起體驗這款遊戲，團隊也會持續努力，期許在未來某一天，能再度揚起新帆，帶給玩家更多嶄新的冒險。

誠摯感謝
孤島遊戲

notes.title: June 21 1.0.3 gameplay optimization
notes.content:
Gameplay Optimization:
●"Falling Rock Trigger" in the Giant Tree Grove Secret Chamber can now be reused.
●Added new tutorial entries related to "Trial of the Lake". 
●Increased the strength of "King of Bees" and "The Master" as the third boss of "Trial of the Lake", to make the difficulty more fitting for this stage.
●Increased the damage of "Flame Breath".
●Slightly increased the damage of "Blazing".
●Slightly increased the range of "Heat Up".
●Slightly decreased the hitpoints of "Gophers" series of monsters.
●Adjusted the amount of Silver Shard required by "Silver Charge".
●Slightly increased the energy gain by attacking with skills.

notes.title: Update announcement for version 1.02
notes.content:
Bug Fix:
●Fixed a issue where the speed when climbing down walls was affected by FPS.
●Fixed a issue where the UI would get stuck for some players.

Control Optimization:
●"Back Flip" now has its own key, no longer requires attacking to be activated.
●Added a new "Interact" key for talking to NPC and picking up items.
●Adjusted the Root Summon key configuration on controllers.
●Confirm and Cancel keys now fixed to A and B (for Xbox Controller, or the corresponding keys on other controllers).

※Please note, due to the update to key configuration, your custom key mapping from older versions will be reset, please set them again.

Gameplay Optimization:
●Added more story when defeated by the Grass Whale for the first time.
●Adjusted the monster placement in the Giant Tree Grove dungeon.
●Added a "Tutorial" category in the Notebook.
●Reworked the Tutorial to make it easier to understand.
●Adjusted the energy gain when attacking with skills.
●Optimized the command input of "Wind Shear" and "Over Load".
●Optimized the "Back Flip", now with a short invincibility.
●Adjusted the temperature decrease rate of "Heat Up".

notes.title: April 13 update notes for version 1.0.1
notes.content:
●Optimized framerate during "Grass Whale" battle
●Optimized framerate during "Furious Snow White" battle
●Optimized some sound effects
●Fixed some UI arrangements
●Fixed some text arrangements
●Fixed some dialog errors
●Fixed the error when talking to Dalton in Lakeside Path under certain conditions
●Adjusted the terrian of Giant Tree Grove dungeon
●Fixed the issue where going through the Military Rat Nest dungeon again would cause the quest to get stuck. If you have already encountered this bug, please talk to the General again to fix the issue.
●Fixed the issue where players can go out of bounds in Lake of Goddess

notes.title: The Honest Elf Early Access is available now, ready to explore The world of fair
notes.content:
Hundreds of years after The woodcutter met The goddess of The lake, The goddess fell into a permanent sleep. The beautiful forest began to be covered by abnormal magic ridge, and The power of The decay eroded The earth. In the course of the adventure, players will gradually solve the mystery of the goddess sleeping, and give real meaning to the mission of the elves, determine the fate of the forest, ready to explore the fairy tale world with us?
Silver Axe The Honest Elf Early Access includes The first episode of The game, in which you take on The role of an Elf sapling and head to The forest with your silver axe. When you arrive at The forest, Dr. Squirrel at The lakeside camp challenges you to navigate The lake. ! Before you can begin your quest to awaken the goddess, you must prove yourself to him.
In the first chapter, there will be three levels lead players around the goddess of the sen, understanding on this stage adventure story, fairy tale to complete the "test sequences", however, you must beat all stand in the way of powerful enemies, in this process, the player will be able to slowly familiar with "root" the magic for silver axe tailor-made skills system, And as you gradually become skilled at summoning skills, you will unleash the powerful power of your elf roots.
At the end of the lake, after completing the final test, I hope to make players obviously feel the growth of the little tree and their own growth, hand in hand to Dr. Squirrel to prove their strength, is the development team expects to bring players in the EA version of the most important fun. We will continue to update the game to improve the experience and open up more content to players.
